text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $85.6K with minimal movement, while Ethereum has slipped slightly, suggesting modest caution among traders despite elevated fear-and-greed readings. Bitcoin dominance at 58.7% indicates confidence in the largest asset, though the lack of strong directional conviction in either major is reflected in relatively flat 24-hour changes. Volume remains robust at $117B, and the greed index holding flat over a week suggests the market has stabilized around current levels rather than building momentum in either direction.
